name: Operations ledger
business_process_overview: Sourcing covers Requisition Filed, Funding Checked, Quotation Received, Bid Evaluated, Requisition Approved.
Ordering covers Order Issued, Line Released, Order Acknowledged, Quantity Confirmed, Delivery Booked.
Receiving covers Receipt Opened, Goods Unloaded, Lot Inspected, Quantity Accepted, Receipt Posted.
Invoicing covers Invoice Received, Invoice Registered, Match Attempted, Dispute Resolved, Invoice Approved.
Settlement covers Payment Initiated, Payment Authorized, Transfer Sent, Remittance Received, Payment Cleared.
